entries.finding: A black body at the 1,879 K dayside brightness temperature measured in secondary eclipse at 3.6 µm (Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)): #ff8300.
